title: SourceGraphService
responsibility: Builds dependency graphs from indexed references, unit ownership and authored scenarios while retaining unresolved-reference uncertainty.

inputs.name: fileNode.path
inputs.description: Repository-relative path used to form a file: graph node. It is interpolated as supplied, without normalization, existence checks or file I/O.

inputs.name: unitNode.id
inputs.description: Unit id used to form a unit: graph node. It is interpolated as supplied and is not looked up or validated here.

inputs.name: scenarioNode.id
inputs.description: Authored scenario id used to form a scenario: graph node. It is interpolated as supplied and is not validated here.

inputs.name: SourceGraphService.build.index
inputs.description: Source index whose files map supplies indexed paths, file classifications and references used by graph construction. The service reads that map but does not index files, resolve imports or validate the index.

inputs.name: SourceGraphService.build.manifests
inputs.description: Component manifests supply unit ids, source ownership, status and declared dependencies. Only active manifests owning at least one indexed source path add unit nodes and ownership edges; only dependencies with via equal to process, http, wasm or contract add declared runtime edges.

inputs.name: SourceGraphService.build.scenarios
inputs.description: Scenario manifests supply ids, covered units and test cwd/target paths. Every supplied scenario adds a node and its covers edges, while a proves edge is added only when the joined test path is indexed; defaults to an empty array and no test is run.

outputs.name: fileNode
outputs.description: File-node identity formed by prefixing the supplied path with file:. The path is unchanged and is not guaranteed to exist.

outputs.name: unitNode
outputs.description: Unit-node identity formed by prefixing the supplied unit id with unit:. The id is not checked against a manifest.

outputs.name: scenarioNode
outputs.description: Scenario-node identity formed by prefixing the supplied scenario id with scenario:. The id is not checked against a scenario manifest.

outputs.name: SourceGraphService.build
outputs.description: SourceGraph with nodes sorted by id and unique edges sorted by source then destination, plus unresolved-reference uncertainty copied from indexed references. It records dependency structure and import mode but does not run tests or certify results.

errors.name: Input access failure
errors.description: The builder may propagate exceptions raised by caller-supplied collection methods, iterators or property access while traversing the index and manifests. It performs no I/O or schema validation and does not wrap those exceptions.
